name: Story: room 6 at the Sierra Motor Court, 04:50 (SC10)
notes: STORY steg 6, the night act. Started by night_array. The old SC10 'Room 6' (S47Chapter4: N. Vega in room 6, her last lines, SARO as the next goal; her call of SC09) on Freeform's motel and its room6_tv (the door of room 6 open a crack, the television inside on snow), started for the story once the player is at the motel (or after the wait's most). Freeform has no room 6 to walk into and nobody in it, so her lines come through the door, over the snow. The objective she leaves is the old SC10's: back to SARO, where the morning act (SC11) takes over. Left out: walking into room 6, the papers on its table, the walkie and Nora herself (the room is the old chapter engine's own area; bringing it into Freeform would be a new mechanic).

beats.text: The phone, once more. A woman's voice this time: This line still rings in the motel office. Room 6, Sierra Motor Court. Bring what the night gave you.
Room 6 at the Sierra Motor Court, beside SARO.
Through the door of room 6, over the snow: East from the station there is a survey bolt in the road. C crosses there.
Tomas walked out to the closing point and did not walk back.
Don't finish his observation. Get the originals out, and don't stop at C.

Room 6, Sierra Motor Court, before five. The door open a crack, the television on snow. A woman's voice through the door: a survey bolt in the road east of the station, where C crosses. Tomas did not walk back from the closing point. Don't stop at C.
SARO. The remote sheets come in at 05:04. Get the originals out.
